forclaz-store-8577504-trekking-usb-recha.text:
Trekking USB Rechargeable Head Light 120 lumens -  HL100 Green
night trekkers & adventurers! This robust head torch is developed by our team of trekking enthusiasts so that you find your way on trails in the night! As a development of the ONNIGHT 100, the HL100 USB is 50% more powerful and rechargeable by USB while remaining simple, versatile and comfortable The flexible casing protects it from shocks and water
ease of use: One button only, easy to handle even with gloves on
autonomy: 17 hrs in economy mode. 4 hrs in high power mode. Micro-USB rechargeable battery
visual efficiency: 120 lm wide beam with a range of 25 m. ideal for hiking and bivouacking
weight: 72g
versatility: 3 lighting modes: Red, Economy White, Strong White
robustness: Shock-proof and highly splash-resistant (IPX4)
rechargeable: Recharge time of approximately 2.5-3 hours
Lighting technology Standard LED lighting. lighting performance decreases gradually as the batteries discharge in order to extend battery life.
Lighting modes The HL100 USB head torch has 3 modes suited to every situation:
   - Red mode to stay discreet in a hide-out, or to protect your night vision
- Economy mode for walking or use when bivouacking
- Power mode when hiking on paths
BATTERY TYPE 1150 mAh Lithium-ion battery rechargeable with micro-USB cable (supplied) and compatible with external chargers and FORCLAZ solar panels.
HEADBAND Removable, washable headband. 
 Composition: 70% polyester and 30% natural rubber for maximum comfort.
 The two symmetrical buckles facilitate tightening. 
 The HL 100 USB head torch adapts to fit all head sizes, including both adults and kids, as well as mountain helmets.
OPTICAL BEAM The HL100 USB head torch's wide beam diffuses light uniformly so you can see in front of you and to the sides
SIZE (L x H x D) 55 x 39 x 31 mm (excluding headband)
Construction Monobloc design for optimal compactness. The flexible SEBS casing provides simple access to the batteries whilst protecting the head torch from impact and rain. The HL100 USB head torch switch is designed for easy use wearing gloves whilst avoiding accidentally switching on in your bag.

simond-store-8600660-usb-rechargeable-he.text:
USB Rechargeable Head Torch HL900 600 Lumen Red/Grey
Our HL900 headlamp has been improved to take you from a gentle ramble to the highest peaks and on all your adventures. Want to explore the world? The HL900 USB V3 has increased its power for seeing even further! Robust and watertight, it has a removable USB battery but also works with standard batteries
visual efficiency: Mixed beam (600 lm max) with a range of 200m It's pushing the limits!
weight: 105g
autonomy: 50 hours in eco, 15 h in medium, 3 h in Power mode. USB-C rechargeable battery
versatility: 6 modes: Red, eco, medium, power (350 lm), boost (600 ml, 60 secs) and flash
rechargeable: Recharge time of approximately 2.5-3 hours
ease of use: 2 ergonomic buttons. Adjustable, washable headband. Locked mode
robustness: Immersion-proof to a water depth of 1 m for 30 mins (IPX7) and shockproof (IK7)
CONSTRUCTION Monobloc design for optimal compactness.  ABS casing with adjustable angle and rubber shock protection 
Does your light heat up while in use? This light is very powerful, despite its compact size. So, by using your powerful light, the lighting unit (the front side) will heat up, which is completely normal. It is, however, important to understand that our lights need to be moved around in order to cool down, aided by heat dissipation. So a light used in a stationary position and/or in a confined space will heat up to an abnormally high temperature and you therefore need to ensure that you don’t use it at a high power level.
Lighting modes The FORCLAZ HL900 V3 headlamp offers 6 modes:
- Static red to remain hidden in camp and maintain your night vision
- Economy mode (30 lm) for map reading or use in the tent
- Medium mode (80 lm) for working on tracks or forest trails
- Full power mode (350 lm) for hiking on rugged trails
- Boost (600 lm, 60 secs) for finding your way off track lasts 10 seconds before going back to 350 lm
- Flash (Blinking) to signal your location
and a 1 hour reserve at 25 lm
Storage The FORCLAZ HL900 USB head torch comes with a fabric bag to store your accessories. The pouch also acts as a light diffuser to light up a greater area around you.
Shock resistance This light passed the test of the IK7. impact resistance
IK means "Impact Protection" and the K from "Kinetic" to stand out from the IP index (resistance to water). The IK index indicates the impact protection against harmful mechanical impacts on a product.
IK07 means the device is protected against mechanical impacts equivalent to 2 joules of energy
HEADBAND Removable, washable headband. Composition: 70% polyester and 30% natural rubber for maximum comfort. The two symmetrical buckles facilitate tightening. The FORCLAZ HL900 USB head torch adapts to fit all head sizes, including both adults and kids, as well as mountain helmets.
SIZE (L x H x D) 62 x 43 x 36 mm (excluding headband)
Lighting technology Constant LED lighting: lighting performance does not decrease as batteries lose charge.
BATTERY TYPE Removable 1800 mAh lithium-ion battery, rechargeable with a USB-C cable
Compatible with external chargers and solar panels.
The HL900 USB headlamp comes with an adapter for 3 AAA batteries (not included). It enables you to use disposable batteries if you do not have a USB charger to hand or if you prefer disposable batteries to a rechargeable battery.
Caution: the battery adapter is IPX4 rated, not IPX7
OPTICAL BEAM The FORCLAZ HL900 USB head torch has 3 beams.
A very wide red beam to remain discreet and see at very short distance (hut).
A wide beam, with warm light, so you can see in front of you and to the sides, close up and in the middle distance.
A narrow beam with a cool light to see in the distance.

quechua-store-8602576-bivouac-headlamp-h.title: Bivouac Headlamp HL50 - 50 lm Black
quechua-store-8602576-bivouac-headlamp-h.text:
Bivouac Headlamp HL50 - 50 lm Black
The evolution of the ONNIGHT 50, this head torch has been developed for bivouacs so that you can move around at night or light up around you. The HL 50 is a very simple to use head lamp.  The flexible casing enables easy access to the batteries and protects it from shocks and water. An essential head lamp that you can take anywhere!
versatility: The HL 50 has a single lighting mode and adjustable strap 
robustness: Shock-proof and highly splash-resistant (IPX4)
autonomy: 20 hours. Works with 2 x LR03-AAA batteries (provided)
weight: 60 g
visual efficiency: Wide beam (50 lm) with 20 m range: ideal for bivouacking
ease of use: only one ON/OFF button that is easy to use, even with gloves or mittens
Lighting technology Standard LED lighting. lighting performance decreases gradually as the batteries discharge in order to extend battery life.
OPTICAL BEAM The wide beam of the HL 50 headlamp allows the light to spread uniformly so you can see in front of you and to the sides 
Construction Monobloc design for optimal compactness. The flexible SEBS casing provides simple access to the batteries whilst protecting the head torch from impact and rain. The BIVOUAC 50 head torch switch is designed for easy use wearing gloves whilst avoiding accidentally switching on in your bag.
BATTERY TYPE The HL 50 head lamp works with 2 LR03-AAA batteries (provided).
The batteries can be replaced by pulling the light module out from the rubber case!
Lighting modes 1 single mode
SIZE (L x H x D) 59 x 31 x 29 mm (not including band)
HEADBAND Removable, washable headband. 
Composition: 80% polyester and 20% natural rubber.
Single buckle to adapt the head lamp to all head sizes, from children to adults, as well as mountain helmets.
